per_file.design-tokens.json: colors/typography/spacing = claude-recall of UIKit/HIG defaults, inferred, unverified, may differ in iOS 27. liquidGlassRegular.cornerRadius=34 and squircle n=4.4 are USER-SUPPLIED. Other material/radius fields null (no reliable basis).
per_file.screens/*.json: all frames = claude-estimate fractions; only the control-center and battery-charging referenceScreenshot URLs are real Apple URLs (the former is the article URL, not an image). 'recents' interpretation is an assumption.
per_file.settings-menu.json: recall of iOS 18-era Settings; iOS 27 order/names unverified; geometry mostly null.
per_file.components/*: geometry generated programmatically (squircle from user's n, circles, capsules); not Apple vectors, so no kit licence concerns but also not pixel-exact.

known_nulls.radius.*: no reliable recalled value for iOS 26/27
known_nulls.material.*: Apple publishes no Liquid Glass numbers; none inferred
